rec.name: Logo Slider (As Seen In / Trusted By)

what.text: A horizontally scrolling or auto-sliding row of logos, such as press mentions, partner brands, certifications or payment and shipping partners. The ticket names it a global section and lists the homepage as the landing page. A comment says it is very similar to the existing 'As seen in' section, and the same product image is reused for it.

why.text: Showing recognisable third-party logos borrows credibility through authority and social proof. Visitors who don't know the brand yet can see that known media outlets or partners vouch for it. This lowers perceived risk early in the funnel. The slider format fits many logos into a small space without crowding the page.

how.text: Built as a no-code section and tested in a Sectionfy demo store. The ticket states no metafield is needed and that non-developers can install it. Add the section in the theme editor, upload the logos, and set the heading, speed and spacing. Place it near the top of the homepage, below the hero, or in the global footer area. Internal documentation exists in Slite, but its contents are not in the ticket.

items: Number of logos visible per breakpoint (desktop/mobile)

dependencies.text: No metafield needed (ticket: MF/N). Appears to be built with the Sectionfy app, which is inferred from the comments. Needs a theme that supports sections on the target page. Logo assets must come from the client.

items: Click-through from the homepage to collection or PDP pages
Conversion rate for new vs. returning visitors
Add-to-cart rate for sessions that saw the section
